title: MOONBOY EP.01 — First Day on the Job
style: Vintage 1930s rubber-hose 2D cartoon, grayscale black-and-silver collector studio, spotlight (match studio/reference/moonboy_reference_v1.mp4)

props.graded_card: A graded trading card in a clear plastic slab with a red top label reading 'GEM MINT 10' (PSA-10 style); original card art: a little rocket orbiting a crescent moon. No real brand logos.

lines.en: First day on the job? Easy peasy!

shots.action: Confident greeting to camera under the spotlight, cheerful wave, then a cocky shrug and grin.
He spots the PSA-10 graded card on a small black display table and leans in close, eyes sparkling.
Nose tickles, he tries to hold it in (two building inhales), then a huge cartoon sneeze; the blast makes the card slab slide off the table edge and fall.
must: card leaves the table because of the sneeze

shots.action: Panic, then instant serious face; classic rubber-hose dash toward the falling card.
Catches the card just before it hits the floor, then carefully inspects it and sighs with relief.
Proud, smug grin and wink to camera.
Fade to black; official 369° Collectible logo (unaltered file) + 'BEYOND THE COLLECTION.'
